name.ja: 30MM 1/144 bEXM-28 レヴェルノヴァ[グリーン]

description.ja: 30MMバイロン軍から待望の重量級量産機が登場！シリーズ初の量産機同士の合体機構を搭載！
description.en: The long-awaited heavyweight mass-produced machine from the 30MM Byron Army has arrived! Equipped with a combination mechanism between mass-produced machines for the first time in the series!

description.ja: • 重装甲の機体を支える脚部は30MM史上最大ボリューム。
description.en: • The legs that support the heavily armored aircraft have the largest volume in 30MM history.

description.ja: • 30MM素体としては初めて腰部に可動式のフロントアーマーを採用。
description.en: • This is the first 30MM body to feature a movable front armor on the waist.

description.ja: • 武装はライフルが付属。
• シリーズ初の量産機同士の合体機構を搭載。別売りのガルドノヴァと合体すれば、重装甲機体を組み合わせて更に大型機体に！
description.en: • Equipped with a mechanism for combining mass-produced machines for the first time in the series. If you combine it with Gardonova (sold separately), you can combine a heavily armored aircraft to create an even larger aircraft!

description.ja: • 既存機体やオプションパーツとのカスタマイズも可能。 無限のカスタマイズで自分だけの量産機を作り出せ！
description.en: • Can also be customized with existing aircraft and optional parts. Create your own mass-produced machine with unlimited customization!
